What each address became

Source: R/institutions_clean.R
institutions_changes.Rd

One row per paper and institution of an [institutions_clean()] result: the address it came from and the institution it became.

Usage

institutions_changes(x, source = NULL)

Arguments

x

An [institutions_clean()] result.

source

Only the addresses resolved this way: `"openalex"`, `"openalex address"`, `"openalex name"`, `"review"` or `"address"` (several allowed). Default `NULL` keeps all.

Value

A data frame with one row per paper and institution: `paper`, `address` (the text it came from; empty when OpenAlex named it directly), `institution`, `openalex_id`, `source`.

Errors

Raises `saqrmisc_bad_input` when `x` is not an [institutions_clean()] result or `source` is none of the above.

Examples

papers <- data.frame(
  C1 = c("UNIVERSITY OF OULU, OULU, FINLAND", "UNIV OULU, FINLAND"),
  DI = c("10.1/a", "10.1/b")
)
institutions <- institutions_clean(papers, openalex = FALSE)
institutions_changes(institutions)
#>   paper                           address        institution openalex_id
#> 1     1 UNIVERSITY OF OULU, OULU, FINLAND UNIVERSITY OF OULU        <NA>
#> 2     2                UNIV OULU, FINLAND          UNIV OULU        <NA>
#>    source
#> 1 address
#> 2 address
